| Track | Length |

If you’d like to hear a particular track right now, let me know its number or name, and tell me which speaker zone you'd prefer (e.g., *Living Room*, *Kitchen*). I’ll queue it up for you!

Alternatively, if you’re looking to explore more than just one song, I can pull up the full tracklist and even recommend similar albums or live recordings from the same era. Just say the word!
